characteristics.name: HIVE DYNAMICS
characteristics.rulesText:
When 1 or more non-token NANOBOT characters you control are destroyed by an opponent, create a BF 1/1 NANOBOT Drone token character.
All NANOBOT characters you control get +1/+1.
